ash.extensions.tryDifferent: Try a different search or clear the current filters.
ash.extensions.installDescription: Install Plugins, Skills, MCP servers, language support, and themes from the signed catalog.
ash.extensions.officialMcp: Listed in the official MCP Registry · {name}@{version}
ash.extensions.declarativeOnly: Installation loads supported themes, syntax and snippets without running scripts. Enable or disable the whole extension in its details. JavaScript execution requires separate authorization.
ash.extensions.accessibilityHelp: Open /extensions to browse and manage extensions. Use Built-in for bundled extensions and Installed for market and local extensions, even offline. Use Tab to move between controls, arrow keys to select an extension, and Enter to open its details. Enable or Disable in a row or its details controls the whole editor extension, including scripts, themes, syntax and snippets. Language packs are managed through the display language setting. Execution authorization and permissions are reviewed separately in details. Use Sources to add or pause an Ash open source. Escape closes this help.
ash.extensions.localExtensionPath: Enter the extension package path relative to the selected workspace directory.
ash.extensions.localExtensionInstallNotice: The package must contain .ash-plugin/plugin.json. Installation copies the package into your profile; enablement and permissions are managed separately.
ash.extensions.localExtensionInstalled: Installed {0} {1}. Use Manage local extensions to enable it and review its permissions.
ash.extensions.noLocalExtensions: No local editor extensions are installed. Use Install extension from workspace to add one.
ash.extensions.localExtensionDocumentNotice: VS Code extensions use the product Node host with user-level filesystem, network and child-process access and inherited developer environment variables. Editor callbacks can receive unsaved text. Grant permissions only to packages you trust.
ash.extensions.noEditorExtensions: No editor extensions are installed. Install one from the Open VSX catalog first.
ash.extensions.noExecutableEntry: Script execution is unavailable for this package or platform.
ash.extensions.extensionsExecutionNotice: Authorize this exact extension to run in the product Node host with your user-level filesystem, network and child-process access, including inherited developer environment variables. Editor APIs receive documents including unsaved text. Package or execution-contract changes require new authorization.
ash.extensions.sourceSetup: Enter the registry endpoints and trusted signing root provided by its publisher.
ash.extensions.sourceIdentity: Choose a unique source ID. Package identities are scoped to this source. Its endpoints and signing root cannot be replaced under the same ID.
ash.extensions.verbosityDescription: Announce keyboard help when Extensions receives focus.
ash.extensions.focusHint: Extensions. Use Tab to navigate and Alt+F1 for help.
ash.extensions.extensionMissing: This extension is no longer installed. Refresh Extensions.
ash.extensions.languagePackEnablement: Language packs are managed through the display language setting and cannot be disabled.
ash.extensions.backendUnavailable: This provider is unavailable on the connected backend.
